title: 4mojis on warning tape
slide_intent: Carry expressive symbols into functional surroundings, because everyday instructions can remain recognizable without losing their words.
strategic_value: The outlined icons paired with Danger and Wet floors can extend Channel 4’s graphic voice into physical workplace materials.
demonstration: Several crossing white strips repeat black Danger and Wet floors text with lightning-bolt and hatching-egg icons.
practical_value: Assess how inline symbols and repeated words behave on narrow, overlapping strips.

content_islands.name: Repeated instructions
content_islands.spec: Run the warning words and their adjacent icons along the white strips.

content_islands.name: Physical overlap
content_islands.spec: Show the strips crossing at different angles, preserving enough complete phrases to demonstrate repetition.

reference_purposes.Expression: Several crossing white strips repeat black Danger and Wet floors text with lightning-bolt and hatching-egg icons.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in physical warning strips.
